# Kostiantyn Denysov

> Technical Lead at Deel in Berlin, leading release engineering and developer experience for a globally distributed engineering organization. About ten years in backend and platform engineering, from fullstack engineer to backend technical lead, staff engineer and now release engineering lead.

## Focus
Release management, CI/CD, database migrations, internal developer tooling, blameless incident reviews, system design, mentoring. TypeScript, Node.js, Go, C#/.NET, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Pulumi, AWS, GCP, Azure, Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
